title: B-tree record-size upper bound

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeMaxRecordSize bounds any record by the physical database-file size, multiplying current page size by current page count to avoid pathological allocations on corrupt input.

external_source_responsibilities: Caller-held cursor/B-tree mutex and valid cursor positioning
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete upper-bound body is assigned using the typed page-size/count dependencies; decoder callers remain open.

inputs: Valid Cursor under its B-tree mutex
outputs: Physical page size multiplied by current database page count
contracts.ownership: Borrowed Cursor/Btree/Shared state; no allocation or mutation.
contracts.state_and_results: The result is an upper bound and may exceed every actual record. Uses 64-bit arithmetic matching sqlite3_int64 intent.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds cursor/B-tree mutex; no callbacks or direct I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Invalid cursor violates source assertions; valid state has a total bound.

representation_differences: The Zig owner calls typed pageSize/pageCount helpers rather than reading BtShared.pageSize/nPage fields directly.

oracle.protocol: Observe a valid cursor over an empty Shared owner and compare the exact zero file-size bound; nonempty native trace remains pending.

assurance.oom: No allocation; this bound exists to prevent excessive downstream allocations.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No direct I/O; lock and pager/count synchronization remain external.
assurance.malformed_input: Invalid cursor state violates source assertions.
assurance.continuation: Pure observation leaves cursor state unchanged.

integration.native_call_path: Typed bound and empty-state unit trace exist; record decoder allocation guards remain pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires decoder integration, nonempty pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.
